server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
notFound: This item no longer exists or isn't available to you.
conflict: This conflicts with the current data. Refresh and try again.
INVALID_2FA: That code isn't valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
NO_SHOWROOM_ACCESS: This account can't use the showroom.
WRONG_SESSION_TYPE: This page needs a different sign-in.
MISSING_PERMISSION: You don't have permission to do this.
PASSWORD_CONTAINS_USERNAME: The password must not contain your username.
PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password you haven't used here.
SHOWROOM_SAME_AS_DASHBOARD: Use a different password from your dashboard password.
UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
IMAGE_TOO_SMALL: The image must be at least 64 × 64 pixels.
IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image must be at most 40 megapixels.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The image is larger than 5 MB.
DUPLICATE: Something with the same value already exists.
ORDER_MISMATCH: The product list changed. Refresh and reorder again.
OTHER_BRANCH: You can only change your own branch.
ORDER_NOT_PENDING: This order is no longer pending, so it can't be changed.
ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED: A receipt is available once the order is confirmed.
PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: Some products are no longer available. Please check the cart.
USER_MISMATCH: Please sign in to the showroom again.
UNKNOWN_LINE: Only products already on the order can be changed.
ROLE_LOCKED: Super Admin always has every permission.
LAST_ADMIN: At least one active Super Admin must remain.
SELF_DEACTIVATE: You can't deactivate your own account.
SELF_DELETE: You can't delete your own account.
SELF_ROLE_CHANGE: You can't change your own role.
BRANCH_ROLE_FIXED: Branch staff keep their role. Replace them from the branch page.
BRANCH_STAFF: Branch staff are replaced from the branch page.
NO_SHOWROOM: Only branch accounts have showroom credentials.
CONSTRAINT: This change breaks a data rule.
CSRF: Please reload the page and try again.
PPF_DAY_FULL: This day already has two full PPF cars.
PPF_DAY_CLOSED: This day is closed. Reopen it first.
BOOKING_CANCELLED: This is cancelled and can't be changed.
DELIVERY_BEFORE_RECEIVE: The delivery day can't be before the receive day.
SALES_PIN_NOT_SET: This page isn't open yet. Ask the call center.
SALES_PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {minutes} min.
SHOWROOM_PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {minutes} min.
REFUND_FAILED: The refund did not go through, so the order was not cancelled. Try again, or refund it in Tap.
